===Etymology 1===
From {{inh|en|enm|mathe}}, from {{inh|en|ang|maþu}}, {{m|ang|maþa||maggot, worm, grub}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*maþô||maggot}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*mot-||worm, grub, caterpillar, moth}}. Cognate with {{cog|sco|mathe}}, {{m|sco|maithe||maggot}}, {{cog|nl|made||maggot}}, {{cog|de|Made||maggot}}. More at {{l|en|maggot}}.

====Alternative forms====
* {{l|en|mad}}
* {{l|en|mathe}} {{qualifier|Scotland}}

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|UK|_|dialectal|or|obsolete}} A [[grub]] or [[maggot]].

===Etymology 2===
From {{inh|en|enm|made}}, {{m|enm|makede}}, {{m|enm|makode|pos=preterite}} and {{m|enm|maad}}, {{m|enm|mad}}, {{m|enm|maked|pos=past participle}}, from {{inh|en|ang|macode|pos=first and third person preterite}} and {{m|ang|macod}}, {{m|ang|gemacode}}, {{m|ang|ġemacod|pos=past participle}}, from {{m|ang|macian||to make}}. More at {{l|en|make}}.
